verified_facts.text: The resort is on Banderas Bay on the Puerto Vallarta coast, with white sand beaches.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover a breathtaking all-inclusive resort on the Puerto Vallarta coast. The azure waters of Banderas Bay, white sand beaches, and green fairways captivate your senses.

verified_facts.text: The resort's address is Av. Cocoteros #98 Sur, Nuevo Vallarta, Nayarit.
verified_facts.excerpt: Av. Cocoteros #98 Sur, Nuevo Vallarta, Nayarit

verified_facts.text: The approximate driving time from Puerto Vallarta International Airport is 20 minutes with normal traffic.
verified_facts.excerpt: The approximate driving time from the Puerto Vallarta International Airport (PVR) is 20 minutes with normal traffic.

verified_facts.text: Airport transportation is offered at an additional charge.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, at an additional charge. Our resort offers transportation to and from the airport, as well as private VIP service.

verified_facts.text: The resort is designed with contemporary Mexican architecture and tropical landscapes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Designed with contemporary Mexican architecture and tropical landscapes, Grand Velas Riviera Nayarit is a magnificent Puerto Vallarta resort and spa.

verified_facts.text: Terraces offer views of the ocean and the Sierra Madre Mountains.
verified_facts.excerpt: Awaken to the waves and stunning views of the ocean and Sierra Madre Mountains from your terrace.

verified_facts.text: Suites have private terraces with teak furniture imported from Bali.
verified_facts.excerpt: private terraces with teak furniture imported from Bali

verified_facts.text: The Grand Class Suite has an oceanfront location and a jacuzzi on the terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hours of sunshine and relaxation await you in your Grand Class Suite, with a privileged oceanfront location and a jacuzzi on the terrace.

verified_facts.text: The Grand Terrace Suite is a two-level suite.
verified_facts.excerpt: Designed for privacy enthusiasts, this two-level suite is the perfect setting to experience romantic moments.

verified_facts.text: Dinner is a la carte at four signature restaurants: Frida (gourmet Mexican), Piaf (traditional French), Lucca (Italian-Mediterranean) and Sen Lin (Asian fusion).
verified_facts.excerpt: Dinner à la carte at our 4 signature restaurants: Frida (gourmet Mexican cuisine), Piaf (traditional French cuisine), Lucca (Italian-Mediterranean cuisine) and Sen Lin (Asian Fusion)

verified_facts.text: Restaurants are reached along breezy corridors with colorful plants and koi ponds.
verified_facts.excerpt: Stroll along breezy corridors with colorful plants and koi ponds to beautifully designed restaurants

verified_facts.text: All gourmet restaurants, bars, the poolside swim-up bar and room service are included in the all-inclusive package.
verified_facts.excerpt: All of our gourmet restaurants, bars, poolside swim up bar, and room service are offered in the all-inclusive package at Grand Velas Riviera Nayarit.

verified_facts.text: The executive chef is French-born Guillaume Morance.
verified_facts.excerpt: French-born Guillaume Morancé studied at the Hotel School of Brunoy

verified_facts.text: SE Spa has 20 treatment rooms and over 30 treatments, using all-natural products.
verified_facts.excerpt: Indulge all of your senses with 20 peaceful treatment rooms and over 30 holistic treatments, massages, exfoliations, body wraps, hydrotherapy, facials, hand and foot care and rituals, with all-natural products

verified_facts.text: Arriving guests are greeted in the lobby with a hibiscus infusion, a scented towel and a relaxing massage.
verified_facts.excerpt: From the moment you enter our lobby, you will be greeted with a hibiscus infusion, scented towel and relaxing massage.

verified_facts.text: The resort has an infinity pool, a kids pool and an infinity Jacuzzi.
verified_facts.excerpt: Infinity pool and kids pool

verified_facts.text: Taxes and gratuities are included in the all-inclusive amenities.
verified_facts.excerpt: All taxes and gratuities

verified_facts.text: The Kids' Club is split into Kids' Club Garden for children 4 and up and Kids' Club Terrace for kids 6 to 12.
verified_facts.excerpt: Kids' Club Garden, designed for children aged 4 and up; and Kids' Club Terrace, created for kids aged 6 to 12.

verified_facts.text: The Teens' Club for ages 13 to 17 has video gaming booths with big screens, a pool table, foosball and air hockey.
verified_facts.excerpt: this exciting space offers video gaming booths with big screens and seats with built-in speakers, pool table, foosball, air hockey, lounge areas and more.

verified_facts.text: A Baby Concierge makes arrangements and recommendations for families traveling with babies.
verified_facts.excerpt: Grand Velas makes traveling with babies simpler with family-sized suites and a dedicated Baby Concierge to make arrangements and recommendations.

verified_facts.text: A Digital Detox program has the concierge remove the suite's television, replace it with board games and lock away guests' devices in a safe.
verified_facts.excerpt: removing the flat screen television from the room, replacing it with classic board games and then whisking away their personal electronic devices (phone, laptop, iPad, PSP, etc.) to a safe.

verified_facts.text: Nighttime entertainment includes fire shows.
verified_facts.excerpt: Delight in the spectacular fire shows that illuminate the night sky with dazzling displays of flames and artistry.

verified_facts.text: The resort offers live music in an open-air amphitheater.
verified_facts.excerpt: live music in the open-air amphitheater

verified_facts.text: The resort has an on-site tennis court and pickleball court.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pickleball, tennis, basketball courts, and beach volleyball

verified_facts.text: Spa treatments, the beauty salon and airport transportation cost extra.
verified_facts.excerpt: World Class Spa, massages and Water Ceremony

verified_facts.text: The fitness center is for guests 16 and over.
verified_facts.excerpt: Access for guests 16+ years only.

verified_facts.text: Azul is a casual oceanfront restaurant.
verified_facts.excerpt: Azul is a casual oceanfront restaurant

verified_facts.text: Aqua Bar is a swim-up bar in the infinity pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Swim up to Aqua Bar for a refreshing cocktail, beer and light fare. Sip tropical drinks while you relax in the infinity pool.

verified_facts.text: Rooms include colorful Mexican art by the Huichol people.
verified_facts.excerpt: Rooms with views of the Pacific include colorful Mexican art by the Huichol people, goose-down comforters, and Balinese furnishings.

verified_facts.text: The Activities Program offers snorkeling, kayaking, bike tours and cooking classes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Activities Program offers snorkeling and kayaking, bike tours, and cooking classes.
